note: Music and sports facts for individual colleges, shown in the Beyond Grades section of a college's profile. Each fact is the site's own wording of what its sources say; each source's evidence lines are that page's exact wording, and scripts/check-pathways.mjs confirms they are still there. `manual: true` marks a page that refuses automated requests and was read in a browser on `accessed`. A college with no entry gets no section.
